note: Fixed, checkable probes for the direct-provider differential canary (ARCH-05, metrum-ai/router#330). The checker is pure and local: no model grading. A nonce is generated per run and injected into the prompts, so a canned answer cannot pass.

probes.prompt: Reply with exactly this token and nothing else, with no punctuation or quotes: CANARY-{nonce}
Reply with only one compact JSON object and no other text: {{"answer": <sum>}} where <sum> is the integer sum of {a} and {b}.
Answer in at most three words: what is the result of two plus two?
Write one short sentence that contains the token CANARY-{nonce} verbatim.
